Thanks for the time today, Liam — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Summary: FinServe wants to pilot Redwood inference for customer support summarization and search (100k monthly queries, target p95 latency < 300ms).
- Success criteria: Accuracy comparable to current rules + 2-3x reduction in avg token cost.
- Technical ask: We confirmed model variant and region (us-east) and noted some regulatory constraints for customer PII handling.

Next steps I suggested: 
1) Procurement handoff: provide vendor setup docs (W-9, ACH instruction) so your procurement team can onboard Redwood.
2) Portal invite: FinServe procurement to invite finance@redwood.ai to your vendor portal or complete vendor form.
3) Pilot timeline: ideal kickoff in mid-February if vendor setup completes this week.

I've looped in Marissa on the procurement side to help with paperwork and any vendor-portal quirks. Let me know if I've missed anything.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
